aspects.says: A PAN that is displayed shows only its first six and last four digits, and the masking is applied to what is shown, never to the data being processed.

aspects.says: Cardholder data travels only over strong protocols such as TLS 1.2 or higher, which in jPOS means giving the channel an SSL socket factory.
